name: Pan-fried white fish with corn rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Season the fish with chili powder and a pinch of salt, then pan-fry 3–4 minutes a side.
Warm the corn and frozen veg in the same pan and serve with the rice.
image_prompt: Pan-fried white fish fillet with corn rice and mixed vegetables on a plain white plate, home kitchen light

name: Egg fried rice with corn
steps: Scramble the eggs in a hot oiled pan and set aside.
Fry the cooked rice, corn and frozen veg for 3 minutes.
Stir the eggs back in with soy sauce.
image_prompt: Egg fried rice with corn and mixed vegetables in a simple bowl, home kitchen

name: Black bean and corn burrito bowl
steps: Microwave the rice, corn and drained beans until hot.
Top with salsa and grated cheese.
image_prompt: Rice bowl with black beans, corn, salsa and grated cheese, everyday dinner on a kitchen table

name: Chicken thighs with spiced corn rice
steps: Brown the chicken thighs skin-side down, 8 minutes, then turn and cook through.
Soften the onion in the chicken fat with cumin.
Stir in the rice and corn, warm through and serve with the chicken.
Serve with steamed broccoli.
image_prompt: Two browned chicken thighs on spiced corn rice, plain plate, home kitchen light

name: Tuna and corn rice salad
steps: Microwave the rice, then chill it in the fridge for 10 minutes.
Mix the rice with tuna, corn, mayonnaise and diced cucumber.
image_prompt: Cold rice salad with tuna, corn and cucumber in a bowl, home kitchen

name: Lentil, tomato and corn rice soup
steps: Soften the garlic in a little oil.
Add lentils, tomatoes and 3 cups of water; simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in the rice, corn and spinach and heat through.
image_prompt: Thick lentil and tomato soup with rice and corn in a plain bowl, home kitchen light

name: Chickpea and corn curry
steps: Toast the curry powder in oil for 30 seconds.
Add chickpeas, tomatoes and corn; simmer 15 minutes.
Wilt in the spinach and serve over rice.
image_prompt: Chickpea curry with spinach over rice in a plain bowl, home kitchen light

name: Crispy tofu with corn rice
steps: Press and cube the tofu, then pan-fry until crisp.
Toss with soy sauce.
Serve over rice with corn and steamed broccoli.
image_prompt: Crispy tofu cubes over corn rice with broccoli, home kitchen

name: Corn and rice omelette
steps: Beat the eggs.
Fry the rice and corn briefly, pour over the eggs and cook until set.
Fold with cheese inside.
image_prompt: Folded omelette with rice and corn on a plain plate, home kitchen

name: Salmon rice bowl with corn
steps: Pan-fry the salmon skin-side down for 5 minutes, then turn for 2.
Warm the rice and corn.
Flake the salmon over the bowl with soy sauce and sliced cucumber.
image_prompt: Salmon fillet flaked over rice with corn and cucumber in a bowl, home kitchen light

name: Beef and bean chili with rice
steps: Brown the beef and drain the fat.
Add chili powder, beans, tomatoes and corn; simmer 25 minutes.
Serve over rice with a spoon of sour cream.
image_prompt: Beef and bean chili over rice with sour cream in a plain bowl, home kitchen

name: Sardine and tomato rice
steps: Soften the onion in the sardine oil.
Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes, then fold in the sardines and spinach.
Stir through the rice and corn.
image_prompt: Tomato rice with sardines and spinach on a plain plate, home kitchen light
